analyst_note: EXCLUDE on two independent grounds. First, the company has an authoritative finding of prior investor deception: a derivative litigation settlement disclosed in June 2023 documented false and misleading statements about the INO-4800 COVID program in 2020. That sponsor-level honesty issue transfers to this catalyst. Second, multiple press releases systematically emphasize viral clearance (37.3% vs 8.7%) as the key REVEAL2 takeaway, but the registered primary endpoint is a composite requiring both histology regression AND viral clearance. Repeated de-emphasis of the actual primary in favor of a secondary outcome is classic masking behavior when the primary is expected to miss. The timeline slips (promising data 5–9 months after primary completion) add operational opacity but are secondary to the endpoint manipulation pattern.
